Game Overview

Naughty Spirits puts players into a christmas experience centered on join Santa in a festive showdown at his toy factory, fending off mischievous spirits with a magical turret. Navigate vibrant, wintry landscapes, strategically upgrading whimsical weapons or boosting health as you battle quirky foes. Experience thrilling waves of chaos and cunning strategy this holiday season, where your reflexes can save Christmas.
